items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Andy Gibson was a great arranger. I think he‟s from Cleveland, Ohio. I don‟t know what he played except it was trumpet.

ctx.x: Well tell me about some of those guys. Who was Andy Gibson?

Andy Gibson was a great arranger. I think he‟s from Cleveland, Ohio. I don‟t know what he played except it was trumpet. But he was the kind of arranger of the old school. He wrote every part. He didn‟t write a score. He sat down and [unintelligible] write a second or third alto and [unintelligible] it would be right.
That‟s some kind of mind, man [laugh].
